description: Looks up the safe uniform load (U), safe concentrated load (C), deflections and weight for welded steel bar grating by bearing bar size and span.

bar.description: Optional bearing bar size, depth x thickness in inches, for example 1-1/4x3/16. Leave out for every bar.

span_ft.description: Optional clear span in feet (1 to 12). Tabulated spans are 2 to 8 ft in 6 in steps. Leave out for every tabulated span.

name: bar_grating_load_tables
